title: MinecraftUniversalis
description: Official Modpack to the MinecraftUniversalis Server!
body:
The official modpack for the MinecraftUniversalis minecraft server!

Modpack includes:
- Recruits mod for leading villager armies
- Better combat mod
- Gravestone mod
- Simple Voicechat mod
- Small ships mod
- Other quality of life and latency mods!

This modpacks intended use if for the MinecraftUniversalis server only!
